pages.text: This chapter provides an introduction to the blood system.
$(br)As one of the essential components of the human body, blood has a major impact on health.$(br)It includes:$(li)Blood Volume$(li)Opiate Overdose$(li)Opiate Addiction

pages.title: Blood Volume
pages.text: $(br)Blood volume is shown as "Blood Loss" in the Blood Scanner. Missing blood volume leads to hypoxia and triggers a chain of symptoms. You can store blood in an Empty Blood Pack while healthy, and use a Blood Pack in emergencies to quickly reduce blood loss.

pages.title: Hypoxia
pages.text: $(br)Hypoxia is caused by low blood volume or suffocation and can rapidly lead to brain damage.

pages.title: Opiate Overdose
pages.text: $(br)Opiate overdose occurs from frequent use of opioid drugs. Mild overdose can often be ignored, but severe overdose causes serious damage.

pages.title: Opiate Addiction
pages.text: $(br)Opiate addiction results from frequent use of opioid drugs. Addiction causes withdrawal effects whenever no opioid drug is active.
